predecision_public_signal: Prior 2019 CRL involved CMC/nonclinical issues, but before the 2020 action FDA reinspected the manufacturing site with no Form 483 and the inspector recommended site approval; sponsor reported no other manufacturing concern.
why_not_promoted: The visible remediation signal pointed toward approval; the later CRL requested additional nonclinical information. A blanket prior-CRL rule would incorrectly penalize successfully remediated resubmissions.

predecision_public_signal: FDA accepted the NDA and the pivotal program was positive; no specific public predecision FDA blocker was recovered.
why_not_promoted: The CRL's primary issue was an analytical-testing laboratory that had moved to a new location; that issue was disclosed after the action, not as a public FDA warning before PDUFA.

predecision_public_signal: Clinical efficacy/safety review was favorable; no public predecision blocker from the remote manufacturing-record review was identified.
why_not_promoted: Alkermes reported that FDA gave no report or feedback on the requested manufacturing records between receipt and the CRL; the blocker surfaced at action.

predecision_public_signal: Publicly, FDA extended review after Pfizer submitted additional data; the sponsor did not disclose the underlying FDA concern in the extension announcement.
why_not_promoted: Later FDA review records describe high-immunogenicity and product-quality concerns, but those concern details were not established as public predecision evidence, so they are barred from the historical predictor.

predecision_public_signal: Public predecision materials emphasized GMP capacity and the active FDA review; no specific CMO cGMP deficiency was found in decision-safe public evidence.
why_not_promoted: The CRL was driven by pre-license inspection/CMC issues. Later litigation alleged the CMO cGMP deficiencies had not been disclosed before the rejection; using them retrospectively would be leakage.

predecision_public_signal: Before PDUFA there was a favorable advisory vote; FDA said no additional premarketing studies had been requested and the extension was for labeling/post-marketing discussions.
why_not_promoted: At action FDA required a repeat-dose study preapproval even though sponsor and FDA had previously aligned on it as a post-marketing requirement. The public signal changed at the decision.

predecision_public_signal: Public efficacy showed the twice-weekly Phase 3 arm positive while the once-weekly arm was not significant; public company material reported the late-cycle meeting completed.
why_not_promoted: The eventual action questioned substantial evidence and the to-be-marketed dose. No sufficiently explicit public predecision warning was recovered to justify a general CRL override without hindsight.
